systems.owner: Ministry of Finance with Smart Zambia Institute (rolled out by); Solwezi Municipal Council
systems.tiers: eight local authorities selected to pilot, Solwezi Municipal Council among them; launched 1 July 2026; all Solwezi council services uploaded for the public to access and pay online

note: An online service and payment platform for residents and businesses, piloted in eight local authorities; Solwezi's finance director says the council issued 30 business levy permits and collected over K60,000 in property levy through it between 1 and 10 July 2026. The article states nothing about the connection of the council's offices.
